Your Todoist day in the Omarchy bar, with a native Quick Add a shortcut away.

![OmaTasks for Todoist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omatasks/v1.0.0/preview.png)

## First release

- **Today, Inbox and Upcoming** in a compact, theme-aware QML panel. Today opens by default; Add task stays at the bottom.
- **Rich Quick Add** with **Alt+Space**, a configurable shortcut, natural-language dates, and pickers for projects, sections, labels, priorities, assignees, and reminders.
- **Task details and editing**, including descriptions, recurring dates, duration, deadlines, reminders, and subtasks. The list and Quick Add share the same editor.
- **Drag to reorder**, with an insertion marker, edge scrolling, cancellation, and API persistence. Drops select Manual sorting; other clients show the saved order with Manual sorting in the corresponding view.
- **Display options per tab**: grouping, sorting, assignee, priority, label, and deadline filters. Panel width and height have accessible plus/minus controls.
- **Direct Todoist API access** using a personal token, with setup inside the panel and a link to Developer settings. No Todoist CLI or extra packages.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Click the bar icon and follow the token setup instructions.

Validation: 47 JavaScript tests, offscreen QML interaction checks for drag-and-drop, cancellation, scrolling, task editing, Quick Add, display toggling, and tooltip sizing, plus QML parsing and Omarchy plugin validation. API tests use controlled responses and do not modify a Todoist account.

OmaTasks is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist.
